title: Basic English — Course 2, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 1

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. Where will the career fair take place?
tasks.audioText: The college career fair will be held in the conference room on Wednesday. Representatives from six local companies will arrive at ten. Students should bring a short CV and prepare two questions about training opportunities. The engineering employers will be near the main entrance. Please register with the careers adviser by Monday so that the organisers can prepare visitor badges.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which two things should students prepare for the career fair?
tasks.audioText: The college career fair will be held in the conference room on Wednesday. Representatives from six local companies will arrive at ten. Students should bring a short CV and prepare two questions about training opportunities. The engineering employers will be near the main entrance. Please register with the careers adviser by Monday so that the organisers can prepare visitor badges.
options: A completed engineering project and a passport
A short CV and two questions about training opportunities
A list of examination results and a reference letter
A visitor badge and a company contract

tasks.prompt: A careers adviser helped Sam compare three training opportunities. One company offered a short placement close to college, another offered a longer placement with travel costs, and the third provided online training. Sam chose the first option because he wanted to gain practical experience while continuing his college course. He checked the dates with his tutor before replying. Reading 1. Which opportunity did Sam choose?
options: A longer placement with travel costs
A short placement close to college
A placement at a company abroad

tasks.prompt: Why did he check the dates with his tutor?
options: To ask for a different placement
To make sure the dates fitted his college course

tasks.prompt: Choose the correct future form: 'I think our group ___ the project by Friday.'
Choose TWO useful details to include in a short CV.
Complete: 'A document that summarises your education and work experience is a ___.'
You want to ask an employer about training. What is a suitable question?
options: Could you tell me what training new employees receive?
I do not need any information.

tasks.prompt: Put the following steps for preparing and following up on a job application in a logical order.
Write 60–80 words introducing yourself to a potential employer at a college career fair. Mention your course, two relevant skills and the kind of placement you are looking for.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: the introduction identifies the course, two relevant skills and the type of placement sought (0–2); it presents a concise, suitable self-introduction for a career-fair conversation (0–2); present forms and basic grammar are understandable (0–2); employability/placement vocabulary, spelling and punctuation are appropriate (0–2).
